text:
zoe: Quick one from the security questionnaire dropbox: customer asked how we handle emergency CMK rotation (they want the ability to force-rotate keys and ensure no downtime) and whether RBAC changes that widen access require approvals/audit. Need two short bullets for the SQ and a 1-line runbook pointer.

mike: emergency key rotation: we support customer-initiated CMK rotation. For hosted BYOK we accept rotate requests via API or Console; rotation is performed by creating new envelopes for new writes while reads of older artifacts use previously-wrapped DEKs. To avoid downtime we do live re-wrap for new writes only; bulk re-wrap is opt-in (PS or self-service migration tool). Important to call out: we never receive raw private key material.

tara: add behavior for "force rotate": if customer triggers a forced rotate and revokes old CMK, any services that rely on the old key will fail to decrypt historical envelopes until rewrap or until the old key is restored. Recommend we offer a staged rotate pattern: stage->promote->revoke. Can include a one-line example.

sre_oncall: ops note: we have an automated staged rotate workflow in Console: stage (new CMK registered), mirror (new envelopes used for writes), promote (switch default), revoke (optional). We also emit a rotation.audit event with fields (actor, tenant_id, old_key_id, new_key_id, timestamp).

sec_ops: RBAC changes: our policy is that role grants that expand an admin-level principal require two approvals: (1) requestor's manager, (2) security approver. Changes are kept in an approvals log and every change emits an audit record. For emergency access we issue time-limited escalation tokens and require post-facto review.

zoe: can someone produce two SQ-safe bullets (non-technical customer facing) and a 1-line runbook link for legal/ops? Keep it neutral & short.

mike: DRAFT SQ bullets:
- Key management: Customers may bring and rotate their own keys (BYOK). Redwood uses envelope encryption and stores only wrapped data keys; rotation is supported and new writes use the rotated key. For bulk re-wrapping of historical data we offer a migration tool and professional services.
- Access controls & approvals: Role changes that expand high privilege access require dual approval and are recorded in the audit trail. Temporary emergency elevation is available with time-limited tokens and mandatory post-incident review.

tera: nit: change "dual approval" to "two-approver workflow" to avoid legalese.

mike: updated: "Role changes that expand high-privilege access require a two-approver workflow and are recorded in the audit trail."

sre_oncall: runbook link for ops & legal: /runbooks/ir/legal-hold-and-key-rotation (internal). Add line: exports of rotation proof include signed manifest and chain-hash.

sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-9002 (owner: mike)  due: EOD+2 for final SQ text + runbook pointer.

zoe: perfect. Action items: mike finalize PR with bullets and include runbook link; tara add the staged rotate diagram to docs; sec_ops confirm approval flow wording matches compliance playbook. I'll send reply to customer after PR merge. Thanks :thumbsup:
